title: Nuke Mod Blehehe
body:
Nuke Mod is literally just a mod that lets you blow everything up. type /nuke <x> <y> <z> <amount> and spawn up to 500 TNT at any coordinate. that's it. that's the mod.
no cap this is perfect for those "i spent 10 hours building this and destroyed it in 10 seconds" videos. or if you just hate your friends' bases. both valid.
what it does:

spawn 1 to 500 TNT wherever you want
4 second fuse so you have time to run (you won't)
works in singleplayer and multiplayer (the server needs to have the mod to works)
no OP needed, everyone can use it
super lightweight, no weird dependencies

how to use:
/nuke <x> <y> <z> <amount>
/nuke 100 64 200 500
/nuke ~ ~ ~ 50

You Need:
Minecraft 1.21.11,
Fabric Loader 0.18.4,
Fabric API

honestly made this for content creators and chaotic server owners. if your server doesn't have this mod it's not a real server. download it, blow something up, post the clip. you're welcome.
use responsibly. or don't. we don't care.
